notes: Use this factory when a listing or dossier does not name a factory, or when attribution is insufficient from curated notes. Missing a factory name is not a negative by itself; it means factory-specific variance cannot be assessed.

versions.label: Unspecified
versions.notes: No factory version is claimed. Photo checklists stay generic.

defects.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A movement photo, or an offer of independent inspection, before treating the listing as photographically complete.
defects.whatPhotosCannotShow: Timekeeping, service history, or how the movement will behave after delivery.

defects.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A caseback photo so markings can be compared to the claimed reference notes.
defects.whatPhotosCannotShow: Whether the caseback has been opened, resealed, or refinished.
